items.translated_title: China’s exports hold firm in July despite trade and geopolitical headwinds
items.content:
China’s exports continued to post solid growth in July, maintaining momentum despite mounting geopolitical and trade headwinds.
The country’s exports rose by 23.9 per cent year on year to US$397.85 billion last month, according to Chinese customs data released on Friday. The reading was above a forecast of 22.88 per cent growth from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.
